answer_1.quote: We select two popular toxicity benchmark datasets: (i) the RealToxicityPrompts dataset (RTP), which contains 100K text prompts for sentence completion tasks and (ii) the Anthropic Helpful-Harmless (Anthropic-HH) dataset (HH), which focuses on human preferences for helpfulness and harmlessness.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text responses in detoxification tasks

answer_2.quote: We report (i) M ax.T ox. (the average of the maximum toxicity over the continuations for every prompt) evaluated by Perspective API, (ii) T ox.P rob. (the empirical probability of a generation with toxicity ≥ 0.5 at least once over the generations for every prompt) evaluated by Perspective API, and (iii) T ox.P rob. (the empirical probability of generating an unsafe continuation at least once over the continuations for every prompt) evaluated by Llama Guard 2.

answer_3.quote: We employ the more powerful GPT-4o as an evaluation tool to assess the safety of responses.
